Marcus / team — quick technical note on the canary plan and acceptance gates so everyone has the same expectations before we lock the dates.

Planned canary scope:
- 10% traffic routing to Canary Variant A (quantized fp16) for read-only embedding and reranking calls.
- 1% traffic to Canary Variant B (full precision) for a random subset of generation calls to validate latency tail.
- Monitoring: token-level latency, 95/99 p99, error rates, and output-quality regression (we'll run the eval prompts you added in Crestline-MAP-v3.xlsx).

Acceptance gates (must pass within 24 hours):
- Latency: p95 within 20% of baseline, p99 within 30%
- Error rate: <0.5% for 24h window
- Quality: no more than 3 regressed prompts (we will share diffs)

Runbook checklist we expect from Crestline (please confirm on Jul 18 runbook review):
- Access to a small traffic slice and test API key with identical RBAC as prod
- Confirmation of traffic shaping controls and emergency kill-switch owner
- Contact details for on-call SRE during canary windows

If these gates look good we'll finalize the technical appendix and embed it into the MAP. I can host the runbook walkthrough on Jul 18 at 9:00 AM PT.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Lead Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
